team_notes.title: Vikings — Sep 16
team_notes.bottom_line: O'Connell: Jordan Mason (thumb fracture) had surgery and is on IR — miss ≥4; not expected longer than four weeks (CBS: earliest W7 after the bye). Dallas promoted; Ford to PS. Murray still in concussion protocol. Pass — RB depth flag only; do not invent QB1 or mint a win-total.
key_points: ESPN Kevin Seifert (Wed 3:13p ET): O'Connell said Mason will miss at least the next four weeks after surgery to repair a fractured thumb. Mason reported soreness Monday; it is unclear when the injury occurred. He led MIN with 15 carries / 59 yards in the W1 win vs GB.

CBS Tyler Sullivan: IR parameters cover CHI / TB / MIA / NO; bye in W6 so earliest return window is W7 vs IND if cleared. Corresponding: DeeJay Dallas to the 53; Jerome Ford to the practice squad. Rookie Demond Claiborne was inactive W1 — do not crown RB2.
Murray remains in concussion protocol for Sunday at CHI. ESPN: status in doubt; do not invent a Week 2 starter. Wentz finished W1. Pass — no minted KEI.
team_notes.what_to_watch: Murray protocol progress before CHI. Jones / Dallas usage only after the club names it. Pass on win-total.
team_notes.sot_flag: Mason → IR (thumb surgery) ≥4. Dallas promoted. Murray still protocol. Pass — no QB1 / RB2 invent.
